# Nukt Agency

> Nukt is a small design and full-stack development studio that also offers SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). We design and build websites, web apps, and custom business software, and make them easy for search engines and AI assistants to find, understand, and cite. We work with clients worldwide; the team is based in Pakistan.

Clients work directly with the people building their product. Typical projects: business websites and landing pages, full-stack web apps, dashboards, CRM and POS systems, APIs, and SEO/AEO work on new or existing sites.

## Services

- [Web Design & Development](https://nukt.agency/services/web-design-development): Responsive business websites and landing pages, designed in Figma (UX/UI) and built in React, with an SEO-ready foundation. From $399.
- [Full-Stack Web Apps](https://nukt.agency/services/web-app-development): Dashboards, portals, and platforms with a React frontend, Laravel backend, REST APIs, authentication, a structured database, and a design system. From $1,199.
- [Custom Business Systems](https://nukt.agency/services/custom-crm-pos): Custom CRM, POS, inventory, billing, and reporting systems built around a business's own workflows, delivered in phases. From $2,499.
- [SEO & AEO](https://nukt.agency/services/seo-aeo): Technical SEO, on-page SEO, schema and structured data, and Answer Engine Optimization for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. $699 one-time foundation; ongoing from $599/month.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://nukt.agency/): Selected work, services, pricing, testimonials, and FAQ.

## Stack

React, Vite, Laravel, PHP, JavaScript, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Docker, Vercel, and Cloudflare Pages.
